title: Fake News (hard)
statementMd:
Now that you have proposed a fake post for the HC$^{2}$ Facebook page, Heidi wants to measure the quality of the post before actually posting it. She recently came across a (possibly fake) article about the impact of fractal structure on multimedia messages and she is now trying to measure the self-similarity of the message, which is defined as

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ffd530e32b4e1499a62543257429c2c2faa2687c.png)

where the sum is over all nonempty strings $*p*$ and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d9287b2e744851dd74014ff331820a0de9bf368.png) is the number of occurences of $*p*$ in $*s*$ as a **substring**. (Note that the sum is infinite, but it only has a finite number of nonzero summands.)

Heidi refuses to do anything else until she knows how to calculate this self-similarity. Could you please help her? (If you would like to instead convince Heidi that a finite string cannot be a fractal anyway – do not bother, we have already tried.)

## Input

The input starts with a line indicating the number of test cases $*T*$ ($1 ≤ *T* ≤ 10$). After that, $*T*$ test cases follow, each of which consists of one line containing a string $*s*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 100 000$) composed of lowercase letters (`a`-`z`).

## Output

Output $*T*$ lines, every line containing one number – the answer to the corresponding test case.

## Note

A string $*s*$ contains another string $*p*$ as a substring if $*p*$ is a contiguous subsequence of $*s*$. For example, `ab` is a substring of `cab` but not of `acb`.
statementZhMd:
现在你已经为 HC$^{2}$ Facebook 页面提出了一篇假帖子，Heidi 想在真正发布它之前评估这篇帖子的质量。她最近读到了一篇关于分形结构对多媒体消息影响的（可能是假的）文章，现在她想要计算这条消息的自相似度，其定义为

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ffd530e32b4e1499a62543257429c2c2faa2687c.png)

其中，求和遍历所有非空字符串 $*p*$，而 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d9287b2e744851dd74014ff331820a0de9bf368.png) 表示 $*p*$ 作为**子串**在 $*s*$ 中出现的次数。（注意，虽然求和是无穷的，但其中只有有限项非零。）

在知道如何计算这个自相似度之前，Heidi 拒绝做其他任何事情。你能帮助她吗？（如果你想说服 Heidi，认为有限字符串无论如何都不可能是分形——那就不用费心了，我们已经试过了。）

## 输入格式

输入首先包含一行，表示测试用例的数量 $*T*$（$1 ≤ *T* ≤ 10$）。接下来是 $*T*$ 个测试用例，每个测试用例包含一行字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 100 000$），字符串仅由小写字母（`a`-`z`）组成。

## 输出格式

输出 $*T*$ 行，每行包含一个数字，即对应测试用例的答案。

## 说明

如果字符串 $*p*$ 是字符串 $*s*$ 的子串，则称 $*s*$ 包含 $*p*$，也就是说，$*p*$ 是 $*s*$ 的连续子序列。例如，`ab` 是 `cab` 的子串，但不是 `acb` 的子串。
